name: NMDC Ltd.
business_summary: Government-owned (60.8%) India's largest iron-ore miner (Bailadila in Chhattisgarh, Donimalai, Kumaraswamy in Karnataka), producing ~45 Mt/yr and selling lump and fines to domestic steel mills (Tata Steel, JSW, SAIL). Also pellet, slurry-pipeline and (demerged) NMDC Steel assets. Q1 FY27 sales Rs6,795 cr, EBITDA Rs2,468 cr (36%), PAT Rs1,976 cr. TTM sales Rs32,127 cr, EBITDA Rs9,249 cr (29%), PAT Rs7,459 cr; market cap Rs61,850 cr, net cash, dividend yield 5%. Commissioned a Rs5,427 cr slurry-pipeline/processing/2 MTPA pellet project on 2026-09-27.

exposures.mechanism: Iron ore is ~95% of revenue (~45 Mt/yr; TTM sales Rs32,127 cr, EBITDA Rs9,249 cr). Domestic list prices (cut 2026-08-08: lump Rs5,250/t, fines Rs4,500/t) track ~65% of international moves. +15% intl => +10% domestic => +Rs3.0k cr revenue (net of ~15% royalty/DMF => Rs2.6k cr) = +28% EBITDA; EV/MCap ~0.85 (net cash), persistence 0.4 => +9.5. Matches pack empirical +6.23 (t=+3.8) within range.

evidence.note: ET/Sahi: NMDC cuts iron ore prices from August 8; lump Rs5,250/t, fines Rs4,500/t
NDTV Profit: Nuvama turns bullish as iron ore prices near bottom

exposures.mechanism: Domestic mill margins set the ceiling for ore price hikes and offtake (weak offtake after muted Q1 per Livemint 2026-08-19); +7% steel supports ore pricing/volume with a lag. Partly overlaps F_IRON_ORE, so kept small.

evidence.note: Livemint: muted Q1, weak offtake and prices

exposures.mechanism: Pricing follows import-parity INR/ton; +3% USD/INR adds ~1.5% to realisation (half pass-through) => +Rs450 cr = ~5% EBITDA x0.85 x0.5 => ~+2. Pack +1.63 (t=+1.0).
Royalty and DMF/NMET ~15% of realisation; a one-notch rise (+1pp of price) cuts EBITDA ~2.5%; x0.85 x1.0 structural => ~-2 to -3.

evidence.note: Citi: higher costs offset Q1 volume gains

exposures.mechanism: Net cash balance sheet, interest Rs116 cr; dividend yield 5% makes it a bond-proxy PSU: +25bp repo => ~-0.6.
